title: Diamond Dogs, Turquoise Days
author: Reynolds, Alastair
review:
3.5/5 so I did really like this but sort of rating it against the enjoyment and satisfaction I had with Revelation Space & Chasm City it's definitely below those both by a fair bit. Did get some interesting stories with quite different flavors from anything I've read from Reynolds so far and some world building that should be helpful to know when continuing the main series.

I do think the mysteries and reveals aren't as good as the main books, maybe due to page count, maybe not. It does overall provide me with more questions than answers about the universe of this world.

Would probably say that these are skippable but maybe my opinion will change after reading more books in the series but glad I read them and they're roughly of equal quality to each-other with maybe a slight preference for the plot of Diamond Dogs.
